name: Nahošovice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of red, black and red in the ratio 1:1:1, with a white forked arrow charge with curled ends over the black.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 May 1995 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
